digest.component_or_area: CLI commands and LLM review integration
propositions: edit --review flag is a valueless flag that parses without consuming the next token, invokes review_plan after the EDIT commit, and exits with disposition codes (0 PASS / 1 BLOCK / 2 INDETERMINATE / 11 retryable)

claim --review flag invokes claim_gate_check and review_plan only when the gate applies, claims only on PASS verdict, and exits with disposition codes on BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable without invoking claim core
both flags obtain _disposition_exit_code via lazy in-function import from _cli._llm_commands following the established pattern
the store flock is released before review_plan runs; review_plan acquires the lock only briefly for under-lock re-check at signing
when review_plan raises an exception, edit --review leaves the EDIT committed and exits via standard error path; claim --review never invokes claim core and exits via standard error path
claim --review prints a skip notice and proceeds normally when the plan-review gate is not applicable (disabled or exempt type)
